exposure: Learning curve analysis based on number of cases
outcome: Feasibility and safety of vNOTES hysterectomy for large uterus
cohort: 39 patients with benign indications and uterus weighing >=1 kg who underwent vNOTES hysterectomy between January 2019 and March 2020.
finding: vNOTES hysterectomy for large uterus weighing >=1 kg was feasible and safe, with advantages of minimal invasive approaches such as fast recovery and aesthetic benefits.
